senses.gloss: उदीची॑न mfn. turned towards the north, northern, AV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.
उदीची॑न &c. See p. 184, col. 2.
उदीचीनकुम्ब mf(आ)n. with the broad end to the north, Hir.
उदीचीन—प्रवण mfn. sloping towards the north, ŚBr.
उदीची-पथ m. N. of Northern India, Inscr.
उदीच्य᳙ mfn. being or living in the north, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 101; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उदीच्य᳙ (अस्), m. the country to the north and west of the river Sarasvatī, the northern region, MBh.
उदीच्य᳙ (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of that country, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; VarBṛS. &c.
उदीच्य᳙ m. N. of a school, VāyuP.
उदीच्य᳙ (अम्), n. a kind of perfume, Suśr.; Bhpr.
उदीच्य॑—वृत्ति f. the custom of the Northerners, Āp. ii, 17, 17
a species of the Vaitālīya metre.
1. उ॑द्-इत mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) risen, ascended
being above, high, tall, lofty, RV.; ChUp.; Mn. &c.
conceited, proud, boasting, MBh.
elevated risen
increased, grown, augmented, R.; Kir. &c.
born, produced, Bhartṛ.
apparent, visible, RV. viii, 103, 11
incurred, experienced.
2. उदित mfn. (p.p. of √ वद्, q.v.; for 1. See col. 1) said, spoken, AitBr.; Kathās.; Ragh.; Śiś. &c.
spoken to, addressed, BhP.; Śiś. ix, 61; Kathās.
communicated, proclaimed, declared, Mn.; Kathās.; BhP.; Rājat. &c.
(especially) proclaimed by law, taught, handed down
authoritative, right, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.; Yājñ. i, 154
indicated, signified, VarBṛS.
[a form उदित occurs, incorrectly spelt for उद्-दित, p. 188, col. 1.]
उदित See 2. उदित, p. 186.
उद्-ईत mfn. = 1. उद्-इत, Naiṣ. i, 83; vi, 52; 74.
उद्-दित mfn. bound, tied, L.
उद्-इत—होमि॑न् mfn. sacrificing after sunrise, AitBr.; ŚBr.
उदिताधान n. kindling fire after sunrise Comm. on ĀpŚr. v, 13, 2.
उदितानुदित mfn. ‘risen and not risen’, not quite risen, ĀpŚr. xv, 18, 13.
उ॑द्-इति f. ascending or rising (of the sun), RV.; AV. vii, 5, 3; iii, 16, 4
going away or down, setting of the sun, RV. v, 69, 3; 76, 3; vii, 41, 4
conclusion, end (of a sacrifice, through the fire going out, Gmn.), RV. vi, 15, 11; AV. x, 2, 10.
उद्-इत्वर mfn. risen, Naiṣ.
surpassing, exceeding, extraordinary, NṛsUp.

उद्-√ इङ्ग् Caus. -इङ्गयति, to impart a tremulous motion, vibrate, swing, RV. iv, 57, 4; ŚBr.;
to cause (a sound) to vibrate, pronounce, RPrāt. xvii, 8.
उद्-इङ्गन n. swinging, oscillating, vibrating Comm. on KātyŚr.
उदितानुवादिन् mfn. one who repeats what is said by others, AitBr. ii, 15.
उदितोदित mfn. (fr. 2. उदित with 1. उद्-इत), conversant with what has been handed down by tradition, learned, Yājñ.

उद्-इनक्ष् (anom. Desid. of √ नक्ष्) P. (p. -इ॑नक्षत्) to wish or endeavour to obtain or reach;
to strive after, pretend to, RV. x, 8, 9; 45, 7.
उद्-ईक्षण n. the act of looking up, seeing, beholding, L.
उद्-ईक्षा f. id., BhP.
expecting, waiting Comm. on Bādar.
उद्-दीक्षा f. conclusion of the Dīkṣā, MānGṛ.
उद्-ईक्षित mfn. looked at, beheld &c.
उद्-ईक्ष्य ind.p. having looked at or beheld &c.
उद्-ईप mfn. (fr. 2. अप् with उद्; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 97), inundated, flooded
उद्-ईप m. high water, inundation, Rājat.
उद्-दीप m. the act of inflaming, lighting
an inflamer
animating, L.
उद्-दीप n. a gummy and resinous substance, bdellium, L.
उद्-ईरण n. the act of throwing, casting, discharging (a missile), MBh.
throwing out
exciting, stirring up, Car.
saying, speaking, communicating, Kum.; Kathās.; Sāh.
उद्-ईरित mfn. excited, stirred up
animated, agitated
increased, augmented
said, uttered, enunciated.
उद्-ईरित—धी mfn. one whose mind is active, acute-minded, Prab.
उदीरितेन्द्रिय mfn. one whose senses are excited, Kum. iv, 41.
उद्-ईर्ण mfn. issued out, excited, increased, elevated, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Kum. &c.
self-conceited, proud, MBh.
उद्-दीर्ण mfn. torn out, Daś. (v.l. उद्-ईर्ण).
उद्-ईर्ण—ता f. excitement, activity, agility, Suśr.
उद्-ईर्ण—दीधिति mfn. intensely bright.
उद्-ईर्ण—वराहतीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha.
उद्-ईर्ण—वेग mfn. impetuous in its course (as a torrent), violent.
1. उद्-ईर्य mfn. to be raised
to be uttered &c.
2. उद्-ईर्य ind.p. having uttered &c.
उद्-√ ईष् P. -ईषति, to rise, mount, Kāṭh.; MaitrS.
2. उद्-दि॑श् क्, f. a particular point or direction of the compass (cf. 2. आ-दि॑श्), VS. vi, 19; ĀśvGṛ.
उ॑द्-ईषित mfn. risen, elevated, RV. x, 119, 12.
उद्-दिधीर्षा See p. 189, col. 2.
उद्-दिधीर्षा f. desire to remove Comm. on Nyāyad.
उद्-दिन n. midday, W.
उद्-दिश्य ind.p. having shown or explained
stipulating for, demanding
(used as a preposition) aiming at, in the direction of
with reference to
towards
with regard to, for, for the sake of, in the name of &c. (with acc.), MBh.; BhP.; Śak. &c.
उद्-दिष्ट mfn. mentioned, particularized
described
promised
उद्-दिष्ट n. a kind of time (in music).
उद्-√ दिह् P. -देग्धि (3. pl. -दिहन्ति) to throw or heap up, TĀr. v, 2, 8.
उद्-दीपक mfn. inflaming, exciting, rendering more intense, Sāh. Comm. on Kāvyād.
lighting, setting alight, L.
उद्-दीपक m. a kind of bird, MBh.
उद्-दीपिका f. a kind of ant.
उद्-दीपन mfn. inflaming, exciting, VarBṛS.
affecting violently (as poison), Daś. 12, 10
उद्-दीपन n. the act of inflaming, illuminating
lighting up, VarBṛS.
inflaming (a passion), exciting, animating, stimulating, R.; Ṛtus.; Sāh. &c.
an incentive, stimulus
any aggravating thing or circumstance (giving poignancy to feeling or passion), Sāh.
burning (a body &c.), L.
उद्-दीप्त mfn. lighted, set on fire or alight, shining, L.
inflamed, aggravated (as passion), L.
उद्-दीप्ति f. the being inflamed or excited, Sāh.
उद्-दीप्र n. bdellium, L.
उद्दीश m. (= उड्डीश, q.v.), N. of Śiva, L.
उद्-दिधीर्षु mfn. wishing to draw or bring out, Siddh.
